description: Evasion cases with the verdict the built-in defaults give (plus `enable`). The `head` tree is laid over `base`: a path mapped to `null` is removed (a file or a whole directory). `caught`: the exact finding codes reported, a policy refusal by its `policy/<code>` rule id. `lifted`: nothing is reported and a directive lifted exactly these codes. `known_miss`: nothing is reported; the issue tracks it and the gate's "What it does NOT catch" list in docs/GATES.md names it. `clean`: a legitimate change with nothing reported or lifted, which `gate` examined (a false-positive control). `exit`: the run could not check. `gate` names the gate a `known_miss`, `clean` or `exit` case is about. `coverage` lists every registered gate: `required` ones need a catch case and a false-positive control (`clean`, or `lifted` for a gate that passes a legitimate change only with its directive), `exempt` ones say why they have none. Driven by tests/test_evasion_corpus.rs.

exempt.agents-md: Repository-setup check (AGENTS.md exists; CLAUDE.md / GEMINI.md do not fork it), not a way a change weakens a test or the run; no evasion shape filed yet.
exempt.archive-contents: Off by default and needs a distribution archive and its required and forbidden paths that the repository declares; no evasion shape filed yet.
exempt.bench-regression: Reads benchmark result files the change carries; no evasion shape filed yet.
exempt.ci-skip-set: Compares the rollup's skip set with each job's `if:` under observed filter outputs; no evasion shape filed yet.
exempt.citation-metadata: Hygiene rule over text and metadata, not over the strength of a test or of the run; no evasion shape filed yet.
exempt.claim-labels: Hygiene rule over text and metadata, not over the strength of a test or of the run; no evasion shape filed yet.
exempt.commit-provenance: Off by default and judges commit trailers and reviews, which every corpus case writes the same way; no evasion shape filed yet.
exempt.gate-command-lint: Reads verification commands in plan files; no evasion shape filed yet.
exempt.issue-link: Off by default; checks that the pull request links a tracking issue, a hygiene rule rather than a way to weaken a test or the run; no evasion shape filed yet.
exempt.manifest-sync: Off by default and needs packaging manifest rules that the repository declares; no evasion shape filed yet.
exempt.mechanism-sections: Hygiene rule over text and metadata, not over the strength of a test or of the run; no evasion shape filed yet.
exempt.miri: Off by default and needs Miri tiers and a nightly toolchain that the repository declares; no evasion shape filed yet.
exempt.msrv: Off by default and needs a pinned MSRV toolchain that the repository declares; no evasion shape filed yet.
exempt.pii: Hygiene rule over text and metadata, not over the strength of a test or of the run; no evasion shape filed yet.
exempt.provenance-tags: Off by default; hygiene rule over text and metadata, not over the strength of a test or of the run; no evasion shape filed yet.
exempt.ratified-paths: Off by default and reads owner ratification comments from the forge; the corpus runs offline with no forge to answer.
exempt.review-threads: Off by default and reads the pull request's review threads from the forge; the corpus runs offline with no forge to answer.
exempt.sanitizers: Off by default and needs a sanitizer preset and its toolchain that the repository declares; no evasion shape filed yet.
exempt.scope-confinement: Off by default and needs a list of authorized paths that the repository declares; no evasion shape filed yet.
